Chapter 696: Chapter 6: Exaggerated Accumulation Speed of World-Breaking Origin Force (Subscription Request)_2

Having a direction for the path ahead, although difficult, at least provided an end in sight.

But Fusion Rules? Fusion Rules were created by the strong according to their own understanding, blending different rules’ characteristics.

In the practice of Fusion Rules, every Realm varied drastically.

“Why does the Life and Death Samsara Rule of the First Realm possess such great power?” the man in the black robe closely observed Lin Yuan.

“Without the aid of any external forces, nor any fluctuations from a Secret Treasure Weapon, could it be his own strength? His physical vitality far exceeds that of a normal Tenth Rank Life.”

The man in the black robe faintly discovered something.

...

The tests of this world did not permit the use of any external forces.

But here, external forces referred to Secret Treasure Weapons, or other high-level reserves and so on.

What about one’s own strength, such as physical soul and spirit will—did that count as an external force?

In the original rules of the black planet, it did not count as external force.

Lin Yuan activated the Life and Death Samsara Rule, which he had only recently comprehended, staying at the beginning of the First Realm.

But his own foundation was too powerful.

Like the same knife, when swung with the force of one hundred pounds.

Compared to the swing with a hundred tons.

The unleashed power was obviously different.

And here, the ‘knife’ referred to the Life and Death Samsara Rule.

The depth of understanding the Life and Death Samsara Rule certainly affected the power of this type of Fusion Rule.

But it also related to the master of this rule.

“Senior, have I passed the test?” Lin Yuan unleashed a strike with all his might, then immediately looked towards the man in the black robe standing not far away and asked.

The man in the black robe had told him not to hold back, and Lin Yuan naturally did not hold back either—his strike was generated with full force, pouring in the vast power of his Inner World, the strength of his physical vitality and soul, along with the ‘Mysterious Yellow Strike’ cultivated to the third stage.

As for the Divine Skill ‘Strengthening’? Lin Yuan did not use it, for if he activated this Divine Skill, it wouldn’t be a strike with all his might, but a desperate one.

“According to the rules, you naturally passed the test,” the man in the black robe said tonelessly.

The original test set by the black planet was, as long as Lin Yuan possessed the power of the Life and Death Samsara Rule at the peak of First Realm, he could pass.

This was essentially the peak that a Tenth Rank Life could reach.

What about the Life and Death Samsara Rule of the Second Realm? Cultivating Pillar-level Fusion Rules to the Second Realm would quickly step into Tier 11.

Although Lin Yuan’s Life and Death Samsara Rule was only beginning at the First Realm in terms of understanding, the power had even reached the threshold of the Third Realm.

“That’s good.” A smile emerged on Lin Yuan’s face.

The test within the black planet wasn’t too troublesome; merely one strike was enough.

“Through that door lies the Ultimate reward of this path,” the man in the black robe looked at Lin Yuan for a while before speaking.

Not far away.

A black door appeared there, unnoticed.

Compared to the twelve massive gates on the outside, this black gate, standing only five meters tall, seemed rather modest.

“But let me remind you,”

“Any life only has one chance to enter this door; if you leave in the middle, even if you pass the test again, you cannot enter.”

The man in the black robe cautioned.

“I wonder if there is any danger inside the door?” Lin Yuan asked tentatively.

“There is no danger,” the man in the black robe shook his head, he didn’t know what was inside, but he was sure there was no danger.

“Then, inside the door, will there be any need to use strength?” Lin Yuan continued to inquire.

“Since you have already passed the test, there is no need for another test,” the man in the black robe replied.

“Can I send an incarnation in?” Lin Yuan thought for a moment before speaking.

An incarnation, unlike an avatar, was a vessel formed by gathering a strand of spirit will and cosmic forces.

Its strength was far inferior to that of the original’s avatar.

The man in the black robe had reminded him that once he left the door during the period, he would not be able to reenter. Lin Yuan naturally had to be cautious.

“Yes,” the man in the black robe nodded.

“Good,” Lin Yuan’s mind stirred slightly.

A phantom figure condensed in front of him.

He immediately exchanged a glance with Lin Yuan, then stepped through the black gate.

“Where is this?” Lin Yuan’s incarnation, after a brief darkness akin to a fish leaping out of water, finally arrived at the destination.

This was a space with a circumference of several miles.

The left half was filled with fluctuations of life rules; the right half brimmed with death rules’ fluctuations.

The two types of rules transformed into each other, merging together.

The end of life is death, the end of death is life.

Life and Death Samsara, an endless cycle.

“Fusion Rules guiding the path?” Lin Yuan’s mind churned.

Fusion Rules, unlike the inherent cosmic rules, had no general direction.

Understanding Fusion Rules was mainly up to oneself.

However, nothing is absolute.

If a being who had reached the Seventh Realm in understanding Fusion Rules was willing to ‘strip’ their understanding, it could be crafted into such guidance paths.

Just Seventh Realm Fusion Rules? Even just ordinary rules between Fusion Rules, reaching the Seventh Realm was the limit for an Eleventh-Rank Life.

If it was Pillar-level Fusion Rules’ Seventh Realm, that was a domain only Supreme Beings could step into.

The Life and Death Samsara Rule before him was indeed a Pillar-level rule, which meant the present Life and Death Samsara Rule’s guidance path originated from some Supreme Being’s stripping of understanding of this kind of Fusion Rules.

This form of stripping was a permanent removal, even for a Supreme Being, it was a substantial sacrifice.

“Life and Death Samsara Rule’s guidance path… reaching the Fourth Realm…” Lin Yuan briefly comprehended and concluded in his mind.

The guidance path of the Fourth Realm meant that Lin Yuan, while comprehending the Life and Death Samsara Rule, could obtain specific guidance from the First to the Fourth Realm.
